窗帘再厚也阻挡不住阳光，房间一片明媚。诺大的双人床上，女子睡得正香，最属特别是她肩头有一朵特别美丽的蝴蝶刺青，栩栩如生，光华逼人。
温暖醒来时，华丽的总统套房只有她一人，长长的头发滑落，遮去背后的痕迹，身上那股介于少女和女子之间的妖媚美得夺人心魄，本是清纯的脸，染了少许动人的媚。
昨晚，是她20岁生日，也是她这辈子度过最快乐的生日。
柳城哥哥去哪儿了？
温暖环视房间一周，不见人影，昨晚有些模糊又很清晰的记忆浮上来，温暖一脸羞红。她很爱方柳城，方柳城也很宠着她，呵护她，可她总觉得有什么不满足。他们之间像是恋人，却又不是，没有恋人之间的激情，她总觉得不够。
她微微一笑，心想柳城哥哥还是如常一般贴心，若是两人一同醒来，怕是不自在，温暖捡起散落的衣服，匆匆躲进浴室，泡了一个舒服的澡。
他可真粗鲁，弄得她极疼，昨晚似是要了好多回，也不顾及她是初次，她的脸不知是热气蒸的，还是羞红的，如火般要烧起来。
泡了澡，双腿间略舒服了些，温暖穿戴整齐，迷迷糊糊间在想，方柳城算是接受她了，她和他是情侣的关系了吧？
应该是了。
他暗示她来，他们昨晚也在一起，应该是请人了，温暖好开心，这一瞬间，她觉得她是世界上最幸福的女孩。
然而，世事总是此般难料，在你最幸福快乐时，总会给你致命一击。
温暖的手机尖锐地响起，她的手机设置了自动开机，昨晚来寻他便关了手机，早上自动开机，她翻盖，一看是柳城的电话，脸上一烫，“柳城哥哥，你……”
“你太令我失望了。”方柳城严酷的声音带着一股寒峭，温暖所有的喜悦，羞涩和懵懂情爱都被这一盆冷水浇得一滴不剩。
她脑子一片空白，完全不知他在说什么？柳城哥哥失望？失望什么？莫非失望她不懂取悦他，她知道他是有过女人的，她是第一次……等等，笨蛋你在想什么？若是你把珍贵的第一次如此虔诚地奉献出去，换来的却是对方一句太令我失望，你还有什么可悲哀的？
你已贱到这种程度了么？
心，痛得无法呼吸，她却仍旧听到自己冷静的声音，“柳城哥哥，你在说什么？”
“昨晚是你提出交往的，也答应我要到酒店来，我等了你一夜，你知道吗？你把人当猴耍吗？”方柳城的声音夹着狂暴的怒气。
温暖如遭雷击！
他等了她一夜，那昨晚的人是谁？

content_en:
No matter how thick the curtains are, they can't block the sunlight, and the room is bright and bright. On the large double bed, the woman was sleeping soundly. What was most special was the particularly beautiful butterfly tattoo on her shoulder, which was lifelike and brilliance.
When Wen Nuan woke up, she was the only one in the gorgeous presidential suite. Her long hair fell down, covering the traces on her back. The charming beauty on her body that was between a girl and a woman was breathtaking. Her originally pure face was dyed with a little charming charm.
Last night was her 20th birthday, and it was also the happiest birthday in her life.
Where did Brother Liucheng go?
Nuan Nuan looked around the room, but there was no one there. Some vague but clear memories of last night came to mind, and Nuan Nuan blushed with embarrassment. She loved Fang Liucheng very much, and Fang Liucheng doted on her and protected her, but she always felt that something was not satisfying. They seemed to be lovers, but they were not. Without the passion between lovers, she always felt that it was not enough.
She smiled slightly, thinking that Brother Liucheng was still as considerate as usual. If the two of them woke up together, they might be uncomfortable. Nuannuan picked up the scattered clothes, hurriedly hid in the bathroom, and took a comfortable bath.
He was so rude, causing her great pain. He seemed to have done it many times last night, and he didn't care that it was her first time. Her face didn't know whether it was steaming from the heat or blushing from embarrassment, as if it was on fire.
After taking a bath, the space between my legs felt a little more comfortable. I was warmly dressed, and I was thinking vaguely that Fang Liucheng had accepted her. She and he were lovers, right?
It should be.
He hinted her to come. They were together last night and should have invited someone. They were so warm and happy. At this moment, she felt that she was the happiest girl in the world.
However, things in the world are always so unpredictable, and they will always give you a fatal blow when you are happiest.
The warm phone rang sharply. Her phone was set to turn on automatically. She turned it off when she came to look for him last night. It turned on automatically in the morning. She flipped the phone open and saw that it was Liucheng's call. Her face felt hot, "Brother Liucheng, you..."
"You disappoint me so much." Fang Liucheng's stern voice carried a coldness, which warmed all the joy, shyness and ignorant love. Not a drop of it was left in this basin of cold water.
Her mind went blank, she had no idea what he was talking about? Brother Liucheng is disappointed? Disappointed for what? Could it be that she is disappointed that she doesn't know how to please him? She knows that he has had women before and this is her first time... Wait, idiot, what are you thinking? If you dedicate your precious first time so devoutly, but what you get in return is that the other person says "I am so disappointed", what else do you have to be sad about?
Have you reached this level?
Her heart hurt so much that she couldn't breathe, but she still heard her calm voice, "Brother Liucheng, what are you talking about?"
"You were the one who initiated the relationship last night and promised me to come to the hotel. I waited for you all night. Do you know? Do you treat people like monkeys?" Fang Liucheng's voice was filled with violent anger.
Warm as if struck by lightning!
He had been waiting for her all night, so who was that person last night?
